answer: Reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life: old endorsements lose weight unless honest service continually renews them. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, a fresh identity has almost no trusted incoming support, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero; cloned identities cannot manufacture transitive trust or cross consensus thresholds. A violet-labeled newcomer cannot spiral upward without reciprocal evidence, while the trusted core serves as a harbor, not an open gate.
